left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients must have persistent low back pain of at least 1 month's duration

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Participating currently in a supervised exercise  [OR] or rehabilitation program  [OR] or enrolled in another interventional clinical trial

left.raw_text: -  Patients with nerve root involvement, suspected serious pathology, unstable trauma to the spine, aspects of pregnancy  [OR] or other conditions that would prevent participation or disallow trial completion within the prescribed time period

right.raw_text: -  Persons with conditions  [OR] that require a specialist consult are suspected of needing a specialist consult, or have conditions that would be aggravated  [OR] or worsened if treated by the interventions in this study
